decisions.reason: Given the prior investment and public launch of this product so close to the firm's established offer, management attributes weak website visibility to temporary causes and continues the commitment.
Because the firm has invested in and publicly committed to this established-offer extension, disappointing online presence is seen as temporary, so management persists with the product.
The firm's sunk costs and public commitment to this core-related product lead management to justify continued support rather than drop it despite uncertain early results.
